## Dataset Name

What should the dataset be called?

## Related Curriculum

Which module, lesson, lab, or track would use it?

## Purpose

What learning or testing objective does this dataset support?

## Data Type

What kind of data is included?

Examples:

- Windows Event Logs
- Sysmon
- EDR telemetry
- Cloud audit logs
- Network telemetry
- Authentication logs
- Application logs
- Detection results

## Source

How will the data be produced or obtained?

- [ ] Generated specifically for ODE
- [ ] Synthetic
- [ ] Publicly available source
- [ ] Donated
- [ ] Other

## Content

Describe what the dataset contains.

## Expected Malicious / Benign Activity

What behaviors or events should learners be able to identify?

## Format

Examples:

- JSON
- CSV
- EVTX
- PCAP
- NDJSON
- Parquet
- Vendor export

## Size

Estimated dataset size, if known.

## Licensing

What license applies to the dataset?

Confirm that ODE has the right to redistribute it.

## Sensitive Information

Does the dataset contain any:

- Personal information
- Customer information
- Credentials
- Real production data
- Proprietary information
- Restricted vendor content

If yes, explain.

## Contributor Interest

Are you willing to create or maintain this dataset?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No
- [ ] With help

## Additional Context

Anything else relevant?
